title: T6-T7 FSU ROM with costovertebral joints at +/-7.5 Nm (Wilke 2017)

quantity.name: ROM
quantity.definition: rotation at +/-7.5 Nm in each single direction, 3rd cycle (polynomial fit), mean +/- SD

source.authors: Wilke HJ, Herkommer A, Werner K, Liebsch C
source.sample: 6 human T6-T7 FSUs with costovertebral joints (ribs cut ~1.5 cm lateral); part of 68 FSUs from 29 donors (per-FSU age/sex: 54f,44f,59m,43f,46f,56m)

protocol.summary: Monosegmental FSUs with costovertebral joints, rib stumps ~1.5 cm, all ligaments; upper half of cranial and lower half of caudal vertebra in PMMA (joints kept free); pure moments +/-7.5 Nm in LB, FE, AR; 1 deg/s (AR 0.5 deg/s); 3.5 cycles, 3rd evaluated; no preload.
how_to_simulate: Model the FSU with disc, ligaments, facet capsules and both costovertebral joints with ~1.5 cm rib stumps (no rest of rib cage)
Fix caudal vertebra, apply pure moment +/-7.5 Nm to cranial vertebra, no preload
Report rotation at +/-7.5 Nm in each direction (and NZ at 0 Nm)
protocol.notes: Values digitised from Figs 3-5 (mean bars with SD error bars, n=6/7). Per-specimen values and hysteresis curves are in S1 and S5-S7 Datasets (not in download folder). Wilke 2017 is not itself listed in Wilke 2025 Table 3, but Liebsch 2022 (listed) re-evaluated 47 FSUs from donors 1-25 tested at 7.5 Nm at 5 Nm - probably these specimens.

extraction.uncertainty: +/-0.05 deg means, +/-0.1 deg SD (automated pixel detection at 200 dpi, 51 px/deg; bar borders and error-bar caps)

ribcage.intact_structures: rib heads with costovertebral (and costotransverse, if within 1.5 cm) joints; ribs cut ~1.5 cm from the joint; no sternum/anterior rib cage

loading.branch: peak of loading branch at +/-7.5 Nm
loading.device: Ulm spine tester (gantry, balancing weights), 6-DOF load cell

shared_sample_with: fe_rom_thoracic.liebsch2022spinej (probable: Liebsch 2022 re-evaluated at 5 Nm 47 FSUs of donors 1-25 originally tested at 7.5 Nm, likely the Wilke 2017 series)
